mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.user_id, c.product_id, c.quantity, c.selected, c.create_time, p.product_name, p.main_image AS product_image, p.price AS product_price, p.brand AS product_brand, p.stock FROM tb_cart c LEFT JOIN tb_product p ON c.product_id = p.id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY c.create_time DESC

SELECT c.id, c.user_id, c.product_id, c.quantity, c.selected, c.create_time, p.product_name, p.main_image AS product_image, p.price AS product_price, p.brand AS product_brand, p.stock FROM tb_cart c LEFT JOIN tb_product p ON c.product_id = p.id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.selected = 1 ORDER BY c.create_time DESC
